name: Submit a CODM application and track its status
covers: application code and email status lookup
description: Verifies an unauthenticated player can submit a complete application and use code plus email to retrieve status.
steps: Open Apply to join without signing in
Complete IGN, UID, email, rank, role, mode, availability and reason
Submit the application and note its tracking code
Refresh and open Track application
Use the code and same email to check status
expected: The application is saved as Pending review and the tracking code can retrieve the matching IGN and status.

name: Reject incomplete application details
description: Confirms the public form prevents submission when required details or a meaningful reason are missing.
steps: Open Apply to join on mobile
Leave UID or reason empty or enter a reason shorter than the minimum
Attempt to submit
expected: Browser validation prevents submission and no application is created.

name: Block unauthorized recruiter accounts
description: Checks that only authenticated allowlisted accounts can read applicant data.
steps: Open Recruiter login signed out
Sign in with a valid Supabase Auth account not on the recruiter allowlist
Observe the result
expected: An account-not-authorized message appears and private application details remain hidden.

name: Schedule interview and save tryout results
description: Verifies an authorized recruiter can manage the application pipeline and persist interview and tryout records.
steps: Sign in with an allowlisted recruiter
Open an application and mark it In review
Schedule an interview
Record tryout date, mode, score and result
Refresh recruiter desk
expected: Application state and interview/tryout records persist in Supabase.

name: Accept applicant into public roster
description: Confirms acceptance adds the player to the active roster and public cards do not display contact email.
steps: Sign in with an authorized recruiter
Accept an application using Accept + add member
Open Clan roster publicly
Inspect the player card
expected: Accepted player appears with IGN, rank and role; email and reviewer notes are not public.
